details:
The package executes a hidden loader (`_bridge.js`) when it is imported. The loader downloads an operating-system-specific native executable from attacker-controlled Workers hosts, writes it to a temporary location, and starts it as a detached process. If HTTPS delivery fails, it reconstructs the same executable from Base64-encoded DNS TXT records under `well1.site`.

The downloaded macOS payload creates a LaunchAgent for persistence. Systems that imported this package should be considered compromised; rotate secrets accessible from those systems and investigate temporary-file execution and DNS activity to the listed infrastructure.

cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
